high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an article by E! News, featuring the 2025 Emmy Awards. The setting appears to be a formal event, likely the red carpet or a photo opportunity area at the Emmys, as indicated by the backdrop with the Emmy Awards logo and the word "EMMYS" prominently displayed. In the foreground, there is a man dressed in a black tuxedo with a white shirt and a black bow tie. He has light skin and medium-length, wavy hair that falls over his shoulders. He is holding an Emmy Award in his right hand, suggesting he may have won an award.
